info.title: OpenSettle API
info.description: Non-custodial Web3 payments API. Stablecoin (USDC, USDT) settlement on the EVM chains Base, Ethereum, Polygon, and Arbitrum. Solana and Tron are implemented at the API + wallet-verification layer (`/wallets` accepts `chain: "solana" | "tron"`) and the chain reader will detect inbound SPL / TRC-20 deposits to verified wallets, but customer-facing hosted checkout is currently EVM-only. Authenticate with a workspace-scoped Bearer API key (`sk_live_...` or `sk_test_...`). All money amounts are minor units (cents). All times are ISO-8601 UTC strings.

bearerAuth.description: Workspace-scoped API key. The key's scope determines which workspace it operates against; the URL `:workspaceId` must match. Permissions: `readonly` → viewer, `restricted` → developer, `full` → admin.

message.example: Idempotency-Key header is required on this endpoint

metadata.description: Code-specific extras. `restricted_jurisdiction` carries `{ code, name, reason }`; `kyb_required` carries `{ kybStatus }`; `attestation_required` carries `{ category, requiredAge }`.

screeningVerdict.description: Sanctions-screening verdict for the payer address. Default `not_screened` until a screening provider is wired. The `screened_flagged` rows are the ops triage queue.

successUrl.description: Buyer return URL, or "" when none was set (the hosted success page then shows no redirect).

hostedUrl.description: Absolute buyer-facing URL (e.g. `https://opensettle.io/checkout/<hostedToken>`). Redirect the buyer straight to it — do NOT prepend an origin. Uses the unguessable hosted-token, not the timestamp-prefixed `id`.

address.description: EIP-55 checksum for EVM, base58 32-byte for Solana, base58check `T…` for Tron.

message.description: Multi-line UTF-8 challenge. Wallet must sign these exact bytes; tampering rotates the verifier into rejection.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but lacks required role / workspace scope

NotFound.description: Resource doesn't exist or isn't visible in this workspace

BadRequest.description: Validation failure (`code: invalid_request`) — `param` points at the offending field.

Conflict.description: State conflict (`code: conflict`) — usually a uniqueness collision.

InvalidStateTransition.description: Resource is in a state where the requested operation isn't legal (`code: invalid_state_transition`).

AalRequired.description: Step-up required (`code: aal_required`). Re-authenticate with a recent factor (within 5 min) or upgrade the session to AAL=2 with a passkey assertion, then retry.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every money-adjacent POST. Replaying with the same key returns the original response byte-for-byte. Different body + same key → 409.

get.description: Verifies DB connectivity. Used by Fly health checks. Body intentionally omits the session count value to avoid leaking deployment volume to public probes.

schema.description: The invoice total is derived from `lineItems[].quantity * unitAmountMinor`; there is no top-level amount field.

dueInDays.description: Days from creation until the invoice is due.

subscriptionId.description: Set when the invoice is generated for a subscription period.

post.summary: Email the hosted invoice link to the customer
Send a reminder for an unpaid invoice

post.description: Returns a session with an absolute `hostedUrl`; redirect the customer straight to it (uses an unguessable 192-bit `hostedToken`, not the merchant-facing `id`). Mode `payment` requires `invoiceId`; mode `subscription` requires `priceId`.

schema.description: Customer: supply either `customerId` (existing) or `customerEmail` (find-or-create). For mode `payment` the customer is OPTIONAL — omit both to create a GUEST checkout (scan-and-pay, no email), e.g. a reusable payment link; the response `customerId` is then null. Mode `subscription` always requires a customer. Mode `payment` takes exactly one of `invoiceId`, a one-time `priceId`, or an ad-hoc `amount` (the latter two also need a chain + token); mode `subscription` requires a recurring `priceId` and a chain/token.

amount.description: Ad-hoc one-time charge in MINOR units (cents). mode=payment only — alternative to invoiceId / a one-time priceId.

currency.description: Currency for an ad-hoc `amount`. Defaults to USD.

description.description: Buyer-facing description for an ad-hoc `amount` checkout.

post.summary: Pause a subscription (no renewals while paused)
Cancel a subscription (now or at period end)

schema.description: Body is optional — server defaults to `mode: at_period_end` with no reason.

prorationMode.description: Records the merchant's intent for how this swap should be billed. **Reserved for future use** — the platform does not currently issue proration credits or charges; the new price takes effect at the next billing cycle either way. The value is persisted on the subscription's audit trail and echoed on the `subscription.plan_changed` event so your reconciliation pipeline can stage logic for when proration ships.

post.summary: Register a new settlement wallet (issues challenge)
post.description: Creates the wallet row in `unverified` state and returns a one-time challenge. Sign the challenge with the wallet's key, then POST to `/wallets/{id}/verify` with the signature. Step-up auth required.

201.description: Wallet created with one-shot signing challenge

409.description: Address already registered to this workspace

delete.summary: Soft-remove a wallet (no longer used for settlement)

post.summary: Issue a fresh signing challenge for an existing wallet
Submit a signed challenge to verify wallet ownership
post.description: Signature wire-formats per chain — EVM: `0x…` ERC-191 personal-sign hex; Solana: base58 Ed25519 (64 bytes); Tron: `0x…` TIP-191 hex. Challenge is consumed atomically before signature verify, so a replay can't succeed even if you POST the same nonce twice. Step-up auth required.

signature.description: Hex (0x…) for EVM/Tron, base58 for Solana Ed25519.

post.summary: Mark a refund as broadcast (chain-reader takes over)

post.description: Returns a new plaintext signing secret. There is NO grace window — the previous secret stops verifying immediately, so deploy the new secret to your endpoint as you rotate. (The webhook retry curve gives you time to redeploy before deliveries are dropped.)

post.summary: Enqueue a synthetic test event delivery for the endpoint
post.description: Emits a `webhook.endpoint.test` event addressed to this endpoint. Delivery is enqueued via the regular webhook delivery pipeline; poll `/webhook_endpoints/{id}/deliveries` to inspect the result.

parameters.name: screeningVerdict
parameters.description: Filter by sanctions-screening verdict. Backed by a partial index so a `screened_flagged` query is cheap at scale. Today's default with the noop provider is every payment landing as `not_screened`; once screening verdicts are populated this is the ops triage surface.

post.description: Returns an unsigned tx envelope that the merchant signs from their own wallet. OpenSettle never moves funds. The refund only takes effect when the chain reader observes the signed tx via `attachRefundTx` after confirmations.

recipientAddress.description: Required when not captured at payment time. Strict per-chain validation: cross-chain (e.g. EVM address on Solana payment) is refused.

200.description: Refund initiated; sign + broadcast envelope returned

post.description: The `signingSecret` is returned exactly once. Verify webhook payloads by HMAC-SHA256 of `${timestamp}.${body}` against this secret; the signature header is `x-opensettle-signature: t=…,v1=…`.

400.description: URL must be HTTPS and not point at private/loopback IPs (SSRF guard)

get.summary: List delivery attempts for an endpoint

200.description: Re-enqueued; worker will retry on next tick

422.description: Cannot replay against a disabled endpoint
